newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma pushes for break-up of monopolies.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma pushes for break-up of monopolies.

text.p: Ukraine must step in and break up huge government monopolies still in existence from Soviet times, President Leonid Kuchma said on Friday.
Kuchma said a paradoxical situation existed in that monopolies in the gas, electrical energy, transport, and telecommunications sectors continued to exist at the urging of government bodies.
"We must create an anti-monopoly climate in Ukraine, and do this by imposing strict controls over income, hard currency profits, and financial operations," Kuchma told his government and parliament.

Kuchma urged parliament to pass a new anti-monopoly law quickly, and said breaking up monopolies was not only the task of the new Anti-Monopoly Committee but also the Ministry of Finance and the Tax Administration department.
